name: Clipboard
description: Copy and paste programmatically: read, write, transform, and manage the macOS system clipboard. Supports plain text, HTML, RTF, images, file paths, and clipboard history. Needs no macOS permissions — the pasteboard isn't TCC-gated, so every tool works with no prompt. Reading the frontmost app's selection is not included: that requires synthesizing ⌘C, which needs Accessibility. Have the user copy first, then call get_clipboard.
summary: Read, write and transform the macOS clipboard. No permissions needed.
